nodes.subtreeText: Ding    3:07 AM Subject: Files appearing as nobody:nogroup in sandbox Hello Daytona Support, Today, many files in my sandbox started appearing as owned by nobody:nogroup. Even root cannot read some of them or change their ownership, and chown returns Operation not permitted. This is preventing the application from starting and blocking access to important data.
